input.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs to Article 11
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, so both Parties are exposed to unlimited direct liability; we have added a mutual cap set at the greater of twelve (12) months' payments and USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality (Article 9/Section 5.8), indemnification, fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and AbbVie's payment obligations are not treated as capped damages.

ops.text: Cap on Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by AbbVie to Harpoon under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its obligations under Article 9 or Section 5.8, its indemnification obligations under this Article 11, its fraud, willful misconduct or gross negligence, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. AbbVie's obligations to make payments under Article 6 shall not be considered damages subject to the foregoing cap.
